source: IMDb episode list for A Cook's Tour (tt0306306), seasons 1-2 -- https://www.imdb.com/title/tt0306306/episodes/ -- IMDb episode list for No Reservations (tt0475900), seasons 1-9 -- https://www.imdb.com/title/tt0475900/episodes/ -- and Wikipedia's episode table for Parts Unknown (CNN, 2013-2018), seasons 1-12 -- https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Anthony_Bourdain:_Parts_Unknown

traveler.source_series: Anthony Bourdain's A Cook's Tour; Anthony Bourdain: No Reservations; Anthony Bourdain: Parts Unknown

assumptions.start_date: episode original air date (the only date these sources publish; filming predates it)
assumptions.cooks_tour_episode_order: IMDb lists A Cook's Tour in production order, so its air dates run out of sequence within season 1 -- the dates are transcribed as published and the trips are dated by air date like every other row
assumptions.cooks_tour_overlapping_trips: two pairs of kept A Cook's Tour trips overlap (S1.E1/S1.E2 and S1.E10/S1.E21) because episodes aired closer together than the 5-day window -- a broadcast-schedule artifact, not overlapping travel
assumptions.trip_shape: round trip out of New York, nonstop each way
assumptions.flights_only: an episode is kept only if a nonstop from JFK, LGA or EWR to the destination airport exists in airline_routes_enhanced.csv
assumptions.route_data_vintage: airline_routes_enhanced.csv is a present-day route snapshot, not a 2005-2018 schedule -- exclusions mean 'no nonstop today'
